title.value: Leveraging Data Characteristics for Bug Localization in Deep Learning Programs
title.justification: The title is directly mentioned at the beginning of the paper and reflects the main focus of the research.
title.quote: Leveraging Data Characteristics for Bug Localization in Deep Learning Programs

analysis.description: The paper introduces Theia, a tool that supports bug localization in deep learning (DL) programs by leveraging data characteristics. Theia aims to detect structural bugs in DL programs developed using Keras and PyTorch at the beginning of the training process.

type.justification: The paper describes the evaluation of Theia on 40 real-world buggy DL programs obtained from Stack Overflow, highlighting its empirical nature.
type.quote: We evaluated Theia on a benchmark of 40 real-world buggy DL programs obtained from Stack Overflow.

name.justification: The paper is centered around improving the software engineering process for deep learning applications by focusing on bug localization and debugging in deep learning programs.
name.quote: CCS Concepts: • Software and its engineering → Software testing and debugging.

name.justification: The paper focuses on detecting and localizing bugs in deep learning programs, specifically through the tool Theia.
name.quote: to support bug detection and localization in DL programs, in this paper, we propose Theia, which detects and localizes structural bugs in DL programs.

name.justification: The paper evaluates the tool on programs using Keras and PyTorch libraries.
name.quote: Theia utilizes the meta-model and performs context-sensitive analysis, namely call-strings analysis and parameter-sensitive analysis using the verification rules to detect the structural bugs in DL programs developed using two popular deep learning libraries, Keras and PyTorch.

name.justification: Keras is explicitly mentioned as one of the libraries used in DL programs evaluated in the paper.
name.quote: Keras and PyTorch are the popular deep learning libraries that provide APIs for implementing different stages of a DL program.
